style: grungy nocturnal urban pixel-art treatment matching the current v4 concept art; isolated object on transparent background; no cast shadow beyond a small contact shadow

integration.rule: These existing rooflayer IDs are overridden by the generated PNGs. The city_block source files and collision data remain unchanged.

assets.brief: A long, battered rooftop HVAC bank: three low metal condenser units, bundled conduit, dark grease stains and scattered leaves.
A square rooftop mechanical plant with two fans, rusted guard rails, cable conduits and a torn maintenance label.
Patched charcoal tar roof section with blue-painted flashing, seams, drains, puddle rings and a few paper scraps.
Weathered black roof membrane with faded green parapet flashing, repair patches, moss in cracks and a service hatch seam.
Grey gravel rooftop service section with tar patches, a drain grate, weathering, loose aggregate and faint utility markings.
Brown-umber patched roof membrane, warm rusted flashing, pooled grime around a drain and small maintenance debris.
Top-down rusty cylindrical rooftop water tank with ladder cage, fittings, grimy cap and a small puddled contact shadow.
Top-down mossy green rooftop water tank with aged painted bands, weathered bolts, ladder cage and pipe fittings.
Top-down faded red rooftop water tank with chipped paint, warning stencil, ladder cage and exposed supply pipe.
